typography.evidence: contact.html desktop_fold/desktop_full/desktop_s01-s02, form_end, tablet_full, mobile_full. Audit desktop families Archivo (212 chars) + IBM Plex Sans (1383); sizes 12.5/16/18/24/38.4/44; body 16px; 0 long lines; mobile h1 clamps to 33.6px with a clean two-line wrap. CSS: body 1rem/1.65 Plex; h1 clamp 2.1-2.75rem Archivo 700 stretch 112% tracking -0.025em lh 1.1; h2 clamp 1.5-2.4rem (38.4 vs 44 = ratio 1.15); pagehead lead 1.125rem/52ch. Footer h2 is the same 8 words as the page h1. .reach h3 forced to 1rem. Previous: inner Gundlav h1 formula still on this page (not fixed); catalogue h2s, index #uses, about table clip not on this page; .cols 50/50 is layout not type; .btn:hover wipe waived.
strengths: Archivo 112% stretch for wordmark/headings/footer phones vs IBM Plex Sans 400/600 for UI -- two faces, industrial roles, not Inter/Roboto.
Measured 6-step scale, body 16/1.65, heading lh 1.1, h1 tracking -0.025em, p max 62ch / pagehead 52ch, 0 long-line hits.
Footer plant/sales numbers at 1.5rem Archivo with 12.5px tracked PLANT / SALES kickers -- the type system doing its job.

issues.problem: Page opens and closes on the identical display line Quote LABSA 90% from Gundlav. Desktop h1 is 44px, footer h2 is 38.4px (ratio 1.15), so the sitewide CTA title sits in the same optical band as the page title and also matches the two 38.4px section h2s (Your requirement / Contact details). Inner Gundlav formula from last round is still here.
issues.fix: Rewrite footer h2 to a quieter line (e.g. Call Gundlav for a LABSA 90% price) and set footer h2 to 1.5rem (24px, lh 1.1, tracking -0.015em) so the 24px Archivo phone numbers are the display climax. Cap .contact h2 at clamp(1.5rem, 2.4vw, 1.75rem) so section titles sit a full step under the 44px h1.

issues.problem: .reach h3 is overridden to 1rem Archivo 700, the same size as .field label (1rem Plex 600). Tel/WhatsApp numbers in the directory stay 16px Plex while DESIGN and footer .phones set numbers in Archivo. Factory / Registered office therefore read at 16px in the column and 18px as footer h3.
issues.fix: Remove the .reach h3 {font-size:1rem} override so directory headings use the 1.125rem h3. Set .reach tel/WhatsApp links to font-family:var(--head); font-stretch:112%; font-weight:700; font-size:1.125rem; letter-spacing:-0.015em; line-height:1.2.

issues.problem: Lead is 18px/52ch/1.65 and breaks after The team, leaving will reply to start line 2. Awkward rag on the only banner paragraph.
issues.fix: Insert a break after Gundlav. so line 2 starts The team will reply. You can also call or WhatsApp +91 97277 02597. Keep max-width:52ch.

issues.problem: Two addresses are joined with a trailing space inside the first mailto and a space-comma-space. Sloppy list setting for the directory.
issues.fix: Stack each mailto on its own line: display:block on the three email links, delete the comma and the trailing space inside the first anchor.
